answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks via micro-barometric attestation. Nodes sample ambient pressure fluctuations across regional zones, spanning from a coastal harbor to an inland orchard. Because atmospheric turbulence and the ocean tide create unforgeable, spatially continuous gradients, an attacker incurs the verifiable cost of operating dedicated physical barometers at distinct locations per identity. However, indoor airflow systems distort pressure readings, causing false rejections.
